Dialogs.Dialog: I want you to know how I feel.
Leave it to an older girl.
I don't have to hold back... do I？
I love you so much... don't you feel too far away？
Your face is red, you know？ Though I think mine is... even redder.
Don't be nervous. I just want to be close to you...
Because I want to feel you even more.
It's a little embarrassing, isn't it？
Things like this should come from the older girl... right？
If that's what you want... it's okay.
Want me to show you how？
Actually... I might be pretty happy about this.
I wonder if I'll do it right？
Huh？ ...No, I was just a little surprised.
Did you want to that badly？
Hmm, what should I do...？ Just kidding.
I wanted to do that too.
No, wait just a bit longer.
Do whatever you'd like... it's okay.
From here on, it's my turn... okay？
I want you to hold me tight.
You can be pretty pushy, you know.
Hehe... To be honest, I was waiting for that.
Honestly, I wanted to be the one doing this to you.
Um, what day of the week is tomorrow again？
Oh, there's something on your shoulder.
Not too close, not too far... right？
You can only do this... with me, okay？
You're the only one... for me.
How can you make me feel like this...？
All my strength is just draining away...
I'm so happy... it scares me.
To be touched like this... I just...
Every part of me is filling up with you...
Are you... just as happy as I am？
I want us to become one just like this...
Promise you'll never... let me go, okay？
I don't want to share you with anyone else...
Hey... Doing this to me... Take responsibility, okay？
So this is what happens to me...
I feel like I'm losing myself...
What you just did... I really loved that.
Whatever you want... Give me more.
Getting me like this... Bad boy.
I just can't stop wanting more...
Can it really get... any better than this？
You can always act spoiled with me, you know.
I love you... I really love you.
If I melt away... it's your fault, you know.
Say it yourself. Tell me you love me.
Wait... Don't look at me right now.
Do I look weird right now？
You can do more, you know...
You're good at this... aren't you？
I don't dislike that, you know.
My head's getting all light and fuzzy...
Well, if you like it, I guess I can't complain...
That's starting to tickle a little bit.
Why are you... so good at this？
No way, not like this... Me...？
Whew... A sound's gonna slip out...
That's... a little mean, you know.
If you don't want to... that's fine, but.
You can kiss me, you know？ Go ahead.
I wonder if I can do it right...？
I'm gonna kiss you first, then...？
You have to close your eyes, you know.
If you want to... I don't mind.
Come on, take a breath and calm down.
Hey now... A little gentler, okay？
What am I going to do with you...？
I don't mind you being forceful, though.
Hey, I was planning to kiss you first!
I was feeling the exact same way just now.
Even without words, I can feel how you feel.
I know how you feel, but... not right now.
You can't just think about yourself, you know.
Hey now, that's not very nice, is it？
Nope. You have to set the right mood first.
Jeez... Now you've got me nervous, too.
Could it be that you don't know where...？
Can we stay like this... a little longer？
Mmm... Jeez, you're way too good at this.
Next time, I want to make you feel good, too.
You completely melted your older girlfriend...
Kissing... really is wonderful, isn't it？
Your heart's racing too, isn't it？
Something like this... isn't so bad, I guess.
Hehe, so that's how you're gonna play it.
Oh... You can do that too？
It's a little embarrassing, but it feels nice.
Are you doing that on purpose？
Too bad, that's a miss... Hehe.
Maybe you're thinking a bit too hard？
I love you, so... it's fine, right？
I want you to... feel me.
Maybe I'll kiss you... You don't mind, right？
Just like this, one more time...
So this is what happiness feels like...
That was a perfect hundred-point kiss.
I felt so close to you.
They say being too happy is scary... It's really true.
I feel like I'm falling even more in love with you...
I don't think it gets any better than this...▼
I know how you feel, but... okay？
I want to tease you a little, too... okay？
Huh？ Did you just...？ No way!
That's not fair! That doesn't count!
Hehe, I let you do that, you know？
Jeez, you're way too good at this.
Let me stay in this happy moment a little longer.
You're not done yet... are you？
Kiss me again, or you're getting punished.
Just a little more bliss... Please.
Do whatever you like, just give me more...
Stopping here is... completely out of the question▼
I never thought we'd kiss this many times...
I feel like... I might just swoon...
I love you... Always and forever.
I love you more than anyone.
Deep inside me... you're always there.
Now I can't let you go.
Every single nerve is tingling in my lips...
I'm so happy I might collapse... Catch me, okay？
Any more than this and I might just break...
It just makes me realize all over again how much I love you.
We're gonna do this a lot more from now on... right？
Kissing someone you love... makes your mind go blank, doesn't it.
Do you swear eternal love？ ...Just kidding.
We really feel like lovers, don't we.
I wonder if there are kisses even more amazing than that？
It makes me want to kiss you again and again.
My heart is just... overflowing with you.
Geez... I guess I'll let you off the hook with that♪
A kiss really melts away whatever's bothering you, doesn't it？
No way, you can't do that.
You don't have to rush, you know.
Maybe I kind of like this sort of thing, too...
What am I gonna do with you... All right, I'll forgive you.
Hehe... You were kind of cute, though.
Haah... My heart was beating so fast...
You really are a dummy, you know...
I guess so... You are a boy, after all.
Yeah, I didn't hate it, but still...
You can't be like this all the time, okay？
